mapper.select: SELECT fof.order_id, fo.status, fo.actual_total, fo.freight_amount, fo.total,fof.refund_amount, fo.pay_type, fo.pay_time, aui.name as userName, aui.phone as userPhone, fof.apply_type, fof.refund_time, fof.refund_msg, fof.refund_remark_pic as refundPic, fof.refund_remark, fo.remarks as orderRemark, fo.remarks as remark FROM folwer_order_refund as fof left join folwer_order fo on fof.order_id = fo.order_id left join applet_user_information aui on fo.user_id = aui.user_id where fof.refund_id = #{orderId}
